scientific_question: Do donors with smaller CA1 pyramidal neuron somata specifically inside reactive-astrocyte neighborhoods show faster memory decline beyond the current CA1 neuron-loss and reactive-niche panel?
approach: Assign cells to CA1 by centroid using the CA1 annotation polygon after dividing annotation coordinates by 16. Keep CA1 cells labeled Pyramidal Neuron and Reactive Astrocyte. Compute contour area for each CA1 pyramidal neuron from centered contours, then take log area. Build a nearest-neighbor index on CA1 reactive astrocyte centroids. For each CA1 pyramidal neuron, mark whether at least one CA1 reactive astrocyte lies within radius r. The donor biomarker is median(log area) of reactive-adjacent CA1 pyramidal neurons minus median(log area) of all CA1 pyramidal neurons; more negative values indicate niche-specific pyramidal atrophy.

variations.name: candidate_variant_a
variations.description: Reactive-adjacent radius = 60 px (about 30 µm), the baseline CA1 glial-neuron neighborhood scale.

variations.name: candidate_variant_b
variations.description: Reactive-adjacent radius = 40 px (about 20 µm), a tighter perisomatic reactive niche definition.

notes: Use only centroids, contours, class labels, and the CA1 polygon; no embedding is needed. Annotation polygons are at 16x cell coordinates, so divide by 16 before region assignment. Center contours before polygon-area calculation to avoid float32 cancellation. Restrict neighbor search to CA1 reactive astrocytes only. If CA1 has too few pyramidal neurons overall or too few reactive-adjacent pyramidal neurons for a stable median (for example fewer than 20), return NaN gracefully.
rationale: Rounds 3, 5, and 6 show that the CA1 reactive astrocyte microenvironment matters, but those recent gains are getting smaller and are mostly compositional. The next focused test is to stay in the same CA1 reactive niche and switch the summary from who is nearby to how damaged the nearby pyramidal neurons look morphologically. That gives a biologically interpretable severity readout and could either add new signal or replace the weaker proximity-only feature with a cleaner niche-injury marker.
